_what: RECREF watchlist (2026-11-03, research only). Each series was chosen by rule: it had open markets closing within 7 days on 2026-11-03 (found by listing every open non-multivariate market, 38,808 of them), it settles on a public number, and that number's source can be read keyless from a GitHub runner. The script names no ticker; adding a series is an edit here.

series.rule_source: Rank on Steam's USA Weekly Top Sellers (top 100 by revenue) for the week. The reference is the store's current top sellers list, a proxy, not the same list.

_parked: Nov 11, 2026 (owner: collect only from sources whose terms allow automated reads). Removed: KXRT (Rotten Tomatoes, its terms forbid automated collection), and, as unchecked terms parked until the terms are read and allow automated reads: KXMC (Metacritic), KXTOPSONG, KXBILLBOARDRUNNERUPSONG, KXBBSINGLE (Billboard Hot 100 and kworb), KXTOPALBUM, KXBILLBOARDRUNNERUPALBUM (Billboard 200). Data already collected stays on quote-data.
_not_included: Open on 2026-11-03 but no keyless reference found: KXYTVIEWSW (YouTube Charts artist daily views, 244 markets), KXYTTOPSONGW and KXYTTOPSONGGW (YouTube Charts weekly top songs), KXALBUMSTREAMS (album streams in a tracking week), the Carbon Arc index series (KXSTREAMARRAY, KXSTREAMINGADS, KXCARTAPP). Spotify daily and weekly chart series (KXSPOTIFYD and the others), App Store rank (KXAPPRANK*), Netflix, and weekly post-count series (KXPOTUSTWEETS, KXELONTWEETS) had no open market on 2026-11-03; add them here when they list.
